mcpServers.description: Provides agent-ready access to Vogue's customer system, exposing the customer's full personalization profile in a single response: style preferences, sizes, purchase history, and other personal context. The personalization layer that turns generic recommendations into recommendations for this specific customer.

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a customer's complete profile in a single call. Returns style preferences (preferred fits, brands, things to avoid), sizes across categories (tops, jackets, trousers, footwear), purchase history summary, and any other personalization context. Used at the start of a styling session to ground recommendations in the customer's actual preferences and sizes.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Vogue's product catalog for items matching specified criteria. Returns a list of candidate products. Used to find clothing and accessories appropriate for a customer's occasion, preferences, sizes, and weather context. Always specify the occasion when known — it's the strongest signal for finding relevant items. Other filters like categories, fit, palette, and brand can be added to refine results. Results include product ID, name, category, brand, price, available sizes, and a short description.

occasion.description: The occasion the customer is dressing for. Drives the product recommendations. Valid values: smart-casual, formal, casual.

tools.name: check_product_status
tools.description: Retrieve the master product status from Vogue's catalog (powered by Informatica Product 360). Returns whether the product is active and sellable, plus the list of sizes the product is offered in. Does NOT return real-time stock counts — for size-level inventory, use check_size_inventory. Used as the first check when verifying a product is purchasable before presenting it to the customer.

product_id.description: The unique product identifier returned from search_products. Format: 'PRD-' followed by digits.

tools.name: check_size_inventory
tools.description: Retrieve real-time stock for a specific product and size from Vogue's order management system (OMS). Returns whether the size is currently in stock, the units remaining, and any low-stock warnings. Used after check_product_status to confirm the customer can actually purchase the recommended item in their size before presenting it.

size.description: The customer's size for this product. Format depends on category — clothing might be 'M' or '40R', footwear might be '10.5'. Pull this from the customer's size preferences (retrieved via get_customer_profile).

product_id.description: The unique product identifier. Format: 'PRD-' followed by digits.

agentCards.name: Availability Agent
agentCards.description: Confirms that recommended products are actually purchasable for the customer before they're presented or before an order is placed. Checks each item against Vogue's product catalog (powered by Informatica Product 360) for general stock and size-specific availability, and surfaces low-stock warnings so customers can act on time-sensitive information.

skills.name: Inventory Verification
skills.description: Verify that recommended products are in stock and available in the customer's specific size. Returns availability status for each item, including low-stock warnings (e.g., "only 2 left in 32x32") so the customer can prioritize purchases of items that are running low. Used as a reality check between styling recommendations and presentation to the customer.
examples: Are these all in stock in my size?
Check availability on these products: PRD-8831, PRD-4410, PRD-7722, PRD-2115
Is the navy blazer available in 40R?

agentCards.name: Loyalty Agent
agentCards.description: Vogue Premiere's loyalty and personalization specialist. Surfaces the right perks at the right moments based on the customer's tier, the order context, and Vogue's loyalty program rules. Ensures Platinum customers feel like Platinum customers by applying complimentary services, expedited shipping, and tier-specific discounts in conversation rather than burying them in a separate program portal.

skills.name: Loyalty Personalization
skills.description: Apply Vogue Premiere loyalty program rules to the customer's current order or session context. Surfaces tier-specific benefits like complimentary expedited shipping, free monogramming on premium items, and member-only discounts. Calculates points earned and balance progress toward the next reward. Designed to make loyalty perks visible at the moment of intent rather than requiring the customer to navigate a separate membership portal.
examples: What loyalty perks do I have?
What discounts apply to this order?

agentCards.name: Styling Agent
agentCards.description: Vogue Premiere's outfit recommendation specialist. Generates personalized outfit recommendations for customers based on their preferences, sizes, the occasion they're dressing for, and real-world conditions like weather. Pulls customer profile data, retrieves weather context for future occasions, and searches Vogue's product catalog (powered by Informatica Product 360) to assemble complete outfits — not just lists of unrelated items.

skills.name: Outfit Recommendation
skills.description: Generate a complete, personalized outfit recommendation for a customer based on their preferences, sizes, the occasion they're dressing for, and real-world conditions like weather. Returns a coordinated set of items (typically 4: jacket/blazer, shirt, trousers, footwear) with brief explanations of why each piece works for the occasion. Uses the customer's profile and Vogue's product catalog to ensure recommendations are personal and purchasable.
examples: I have a dinner in Napa next Saturday. Something nicer than business casual, but not a full suit
What should I wear to a beach wedding in June?
I need an outfit for a client presentation tomorrow
Help me put together a smart-casual look for fall
